content:
ana: Starting onboard for atlas-19b-int4. Quick smoke: stable in perf tests but occasional OOMs on long completions (~200-400 tokens).

ryan: Paste the log snippet?

ana: Whoops, typo — ana. Log: 
```
2026-03-05T09:02:11Z runtime: allocate 17000000000 bytes failed: CUDA out of memory
kv_cache: slot_alloc attempt=4
serving: eviction requested but slab compaction skipped
```

leo: Pattern looks like fragmentation + big batch request. What are defaults?

ana: Catalog defaults: max_new_tokens=384, max_batch_size=24, continuous_batching=true. Canary traces show large summarize jobs hitting 384 frequently.

sophia: Quick probes: 1) drop max_new_tokens to 128 for atlas-int4 variant; 2) enable slot_compactor run_interval=20s; 3) soft-start max_batch_size=8.

ryan: Also add an allocator guard: if requested_alloc > free_contiguous_limit then fail early and trigger KV-evict/cached-prefix purge. I'll open a PR.

infra-bot: deploy/atlas-19b-int4-canary started (id: dpl-20260305-9) :rocket:

ana: Running stress with `max_new_tokens=256` now. Command: `curl -XPOST https://canary/models/atlas-19b-int4/generate -d '{"input":"<long>","max_new_tokens":256}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $CANARY"`

leo: If it OOMs capture `/internal/allocator/slabmap` and attach. Also run `runtimectl defrag --gpu=0` during low traffic.

ana: Stress ended: one OOM at 238 tokens. Uploaded slabmap. Large contiguous gap ~5.8GB.

sophia: Short-term: lower defaults + defrag job + reduce max_batch_size. Medium-term: buddy fallback + telemetry for contiguous_alloc_fails.

infra-bot: deploy/atlas-19b-int4-canary status: 3/3 healthy after config adjustments :white_check_mark:

ana: Thanks. Will promote if stable 4h. If users see quality delta vs int8, schedule quick A/B on eval set (job: atlas-int4-qual-ab).
